Manik Thakral vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 8 August, 2024 
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
? Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:128710-Db
Court No. - 40 
Case :- Writ - C No. - 21997 of 2024 
Petitioner :- Manik Thakral
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others 
Counsel for Petitioner :- Chetan Chatterjee
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Shekhar B. Saraf,J.
Hon'ble Manjive Shukla,J.
1.  This is a writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India wherein the petitioner is aggrieved by the inaction on the part of the respondent authorities in considering the claim of the petitioner for running Hukka Parlour. 
2. Counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the petitioner has filed an application/representation in light of the order dated February 21, 2023 passed by the coordinate Bench of this Court in Public Interest Litigation (PIL) No.716 of 2020 titled as Suo Motu v. State of U.P. and others. 
3. Having heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the parties, we are of the view that respondent No.3 should be directed to consider the claim of the petitioner. 
Manik Thakral vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193813155/
1 4. Accordingly, Assistant Commissioner (Food) II/Designated Officer, Food Safety and Drugs A d m i n i s t r a t i o n , S a h a r a n p u r / r e s p o n d e n t N o . 3 i s d i r e c t e d t o c o n s i d e r t h e application/representation dated March 27, 2024 moved by the petitioner and after granting an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner pass a reasoned order in accordance with law within a period of six weeks from date.
5 . With the above direction, the writ petition is disposed of. 
Order Date :- 8.8.2024 Kuldeep (Manjive Shukla, J.) (Shekhar B. Saraf, J.)
